Spend £75 or more on qualifying STANLEY or STANLEY FATMAX hand tools or storage products to claim a FREE STANLEY FATMAX XTREME 120cm Box Beam Level (FMHT43676-1). UK & ROI residents aged 18+ only. Purchase on or between 01.09.2026 - 24.11.2026. Claim online at STANLEYtools.co.uk by 07.12.2026 with proof of purchase. 5,000 available, first come, first served. Full T&Cs apply. Manufacturer promotion.

The Stanley 15 litre heavy-duty tool backpack is designed for hands-free tool transport on site. Made from durable 600 denier polyester, it delivers long service life and weather resistance in demanding trade environments. A rigid waterproof polyethylene base protects tools from dirt, moisture and ground contact. Storage includes three external pockets and seventeen internal pockets, with a removable inner compartment for organised and secure tool storage. The dual-zipped opening allows full access to contents, with padded shoulder straps, a padded back panel, and a top carry handle supporting loads up to 15 kg. Suitable for maintenance and installation work where mobility and organised tool storage are required.
